searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints into measurable recommendation failures: redundant purchases, unsupported compatibility, and broad resemblance without specific relevance. Seek evidence-grounded methods using only histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps, with explicit abstention when specifications or preferences are unknown. Validate these probes against available user judgments; keep uncertain identification separate from rejection.

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics identify effective training changes rather than merely describe model behavior.
